notes.title: Release Version 1.0
notes.content:
It's finally here, Store Crasher has been completed!  Hop in today and start crashing those stores!  Im happy with how the game has turned out and i hope you all enjoy it.  If there are any issues please feel free to contact me here or on my twitter.   There was a lot to clean up before release so heres the change log:

Added:
- Loading screen to multiplayer
- More weapons to find in Level 2
- Changed level preview pictures
- Free cam mode (accessible by pressing 'f1' and typing "freecam")

Fixed: 
- AI not animating and sliding around
- Some UI not fitting on different screen sizes
- Crosshair overlapping the pause menu
- Equipped ruby upgrades not being saved on game exit
- AI not cycling dialogue
- Pathing on Level 3
- Lowered fall damage threshold
- Short shelves exploding on game start
- vehicle sounds not turning off after exit
- Police not showing up on Level 5
- Box bundle not giving money on destroy
- Exit sign not facing player online
- Enemies not animating their attacks
- Post processing not showing up on some levels
- Exit sign not looking at player if they are in a vehicle when its spawned

notes.title: Update 0.7.1
notes.content:
Following up on the previous update that overhauled the 2nd level, with Update 0.7.1 I took to updating and making all the other levels look up to par.  Many new areas have been added to the previously pretty barren levels with only one or two mapped out areas.  As always if you have any issues please post them here or contact me via twitter.

- Added smaller stores to 3rd level
- Added a back room to 4th level
- Added detailing to all levels
- Fixed an issue with smaller screens having issues with UI
- Bug fixes

Things should be wrapping up soon I've got a list of issues i'm working on some more important than others looking at you sliding AI.  With release coming up i will let everyone know now that the price will be increasing so now is your chance to get it at a good price!

As always stay tuned for more soon!

- Ty

notes.title: Update 0.7
notes.content:
Update 0.7 was a look into how to make levels more accurate to model and real life sizes.  The update introduced the final level (probably) being added Level 6, and completely reworked how Level 2 played and looked.  Other levels still need a face lift and some size work that will be in a future update. We are nearing the home stretch for full release, but still have a ways to go. Look forward to more in the coming months!

- Ty

-Overhauled 2nd level
-Added new vehicle (shopping scooter)
